name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: PetDesk does for clinics what I build for service businesses at Solenzo: appointment confirmations and reminders, no-show recovery, bringing lapsed clients back, and review requests. I know how much those workflows matter to a busy front desk, and how easy it is to configure them in a way the staff never actually uses.

Running a pipeline of 30 to 40 implementations is familiar too. At Wix I carried up to 25 onboardings at once and launched 25+ clients a month at 110% of my implementation target, mostly on calls with small-business owners. At Birdeye I onboarded and trained partners on reputation management and marketing automation tools, including healthcare-focused agencies, and retained all but one of 15 to 20.
I haven't worked with veterinary clinics yet, and I'd learn your customers' workflows quickly. Open to a conversation at 303-726-5037 or jrotnbrg@gmail.com.
